title: Levuvo SF feature list (A3, GA3.3-GA3.5)
description: Source of docs/FEATURES.md (rendered by the factory). IDs and statuses are set by the factory only.

prd_version.description: PRD version the scope check was made against.

priority.description: MoSCoW, preliminary; the work order is the backlog (backlog.json, D).

scope_ref.description: Capability in PRD section 7 this feature belongs to (GA3.4).

status.description: Set by the factory state machine only (GA3.5). A3/A6: proposed, approved, removed. B: specifying (B1), ready (spec approved), in_progress (B2-B6), waiting (needs a release of an own library or a baseline revision, A6), in_acceptance (B7), done (merged).

spec_version.description: Released spec version (G1.5); set by the factory.

released_in.description: SemVer version the feature shipped in (B7); set by the factory.
